evidence.source: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline — Drugs of Unproven Value or That May Worsen HF
evidence.quote: COR 3: No Benefit, LOE A - In patients with HFrEF, dihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs are not recommended treatment for HF. COR 3: Harm, LOE A - In patients with HFrEF, nondihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs are not recommended.

rules.title: Start two drugs, preferably as a single pill, in stage 2 hypertension
rules.mechanism: Two agents acting on different mechanisms produce roughly additive blood-pressure reduction, whereas doubling one agent's dose adds little, so combination therapy reaches target faster and with fewer dose-dependent adverse effects.

provenance.quote: For stage 2 hypertension: initiating treatment with two first-line antihypertensive agents of different classes, preferably in a single-pill, fixed-dose combination. This approach improves adherence and reduces the time needed to achieve BP control.

warning.short: Stage 2 — start two classes, ideally one pill
warning.full: At BP 140/90 or above, start two first-line agents of different classes, preferably as a single-pill fixed-dose combination. This is the guideline hook for the two real fixed-dose combination products in the modeled set: lisinopril/HCTZ and losartan/HCTZ. Note the metabolic caveat encoded separately in DDI-BB-THIAZIDE-DYSGLYCEMIA: a beta-blocker plus thiazide is the one pairing current guidelines steer away from as initial therapy.

evidence.source: 2025 AHA/ACC/multisociety High Blood Pressure Guideline
evidence.quote: initiating treatment with two first-line antihypertensive agents of different classes, preferably in a single-pill, fixed-dose combination

rules.title: Beta-blocker plus thiazide — metabolic penalty as initial therapy
rules.mechanism: Thiazide-induced hypokalemia impairs insulin secretion while beta blockade reduces peripheral insulin sensitivity and blunts the counter-regulatory response, so the two agents worsen glucose handling in the same direction.

effects.estimate_basis: Per-dose glycemic deltas for HCTZ could not be sourced (Cochrane reports the direction and notes 'high risk of bias in the metabolic data'); +5 mg/dL over 6 months is a flagged modelling estimate.

Directional placeholder consistent with the guideline caution and with ALLHAT's higher new-onset diabetes on chlorthalidone versus amlodipine and lisinopril; no single ratio for the metoprolol+HCTZ pair was retrieved.

warning.short: Beta-blocker + thiazide — avoid as initial therapy
warning.full: Current guidelines steer away from a beta-blocker plus diuretic as initial antihypertensive therapy because of the combined metabolic risk. Use it when the beta-blocker has its own compelling indication, not to reach a blood-pressure target. Monitor glucose and potassium.

evidence.source: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of elevated blood pressure and hypertension
evidence.quote: Beta-blockers are associated with an increased risk of diabetes in some patients, particularly when used with diuretics. ... beta blockers are not considered as first line, they are recommended in combination with first line medications when there is a compelling indication.

rules.title: Dose-dependent visible adverse effect channels
rules.mechanism: Each modeled drug has one adverse effect a lay viewer recognises immediately, which is what makes the animation credible rather than promotional.

provenance.source: FDA label, amlodipine besylate tablets §6.1 — dose-related adverse reaction table
provenance.quote: The incidence (%) of side effects that occurred in a dose related manner are as follows: Amlodipine Placebo N=520, 2.5 mg N=275, 5 mg N=296, 10 mg N=268 — Edema 1.8 3.0 10.8 0.6
provenance.note: Label also reports a greater incidence in women than men for dose-related effects; that split is carried in the separate sex-stratified effect below and must be applied ON TOP of this curve, never as a substitute for it.

provenance.source: FDA label, amlodipine besylate tablets §6.1 — sex-stratified adverse reaction table
provenance.quote: For several adverse experiences that appear to be drug and dose related, there was a greater incidence in women than men associated with amlodipine treatment as shown in the following table: Amlodipine Besylate Placebo / Male = % Female = % Male = % Female = % / (N = 1218) (N = 512) (N = 914) (N = 336) / Edema 5.6 14.6 1.4 5.1

effects.derivation_note: The four percentages, the four Ns and the placebo comparators are quoted verbatim from the label. The two MULTIPLIER sets are DERIVED by me, not label values — arithmetic shown so it is auditable. Pooled both-sex amlodipine incidence = (1218*5.6 + 512*14.6)/1730 = 8.26%. Raw multipliers = 5.6/8.26 = 0.68 and 14.6/8.26 = 1.77. Placebo-subtracted attributable risk = male 5.6-1.4 = 4.2, female 14.6-5.1 = 9.5, pooled = (1218*4.2 + 512*9.5)/1730 = 4.87; multipliers = 4.2/4.87 = 0.86 and 9.5/4.87 = 1.94.
effects.consumer_instructions: USE recommended_multiplier (placebo-subtracted). The placebo arm shows the SAME sex skew (1.4% male vs 5.1% female), so a substantial part of the raw gap is background oedema in women, not drug effect. Attributing all of it to amlodipine would overstate the drug's sex difference. Apply multiplicatively to the interpolated dose_response value: risk = interpolate(dose_response, mg) * recommended_multiplier[sex]. Do NOT modify the dose_response points.
effects.caveat: IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the label's sex table is POOLED ACROSS DOSES (N=1730, i.e. the full trial population), whereas dose_response comes from the smaller dose-stratified subset (N=1359 across four arms). There is no published sex-BY-dose cell. Combining them assumes the sex effect is a constant proportional hazard across 2.5-10 mg, which the label neither states nor contradicts. This assumption is the reason a female archetype may select 5 mg over 10 mg — it is a defensible modelling choice built on cited data, but the interaction term itself is assumed, and the report should say so rather than implying the label prescribes a lower dose in women.

provenance.quote: The following adverse reactions (events 2% greater on lisinopril than on placebo) were observed with lisinopril alone: headache (by 3.8%), dizziness (by 3.5%), cough (by 2.5%).

provenance.source: Bangalore S et al., Am J Med 2010 — 125 studies, 198,130 patients
provenance.quote: pooled weighted incidence for enalapril 11.48% (95% CI 9.54-13.41), withdrawal for cough 2.57% (95% CI 2.40-2.74)
provenance.note: Use this, not the label figure, for a realistic simulation. Label trial rates badly understate ACEi cough.

provenance.quote: hyperkalemia (serum potassium greater than 5.7 mEq/L) occurred in 2.2% and 4.8% of lisinopril tablets-treated patients with hypertension and heart failure, respectively

provenance.source: OCTAVE trial enalapril arm (n approx 25,000), Am J Hypertens 2004;17:103
provenance.quote: angioedema 0.68% overall on enalapril; in Blacks 1.62% enalapril
provenance.note: The lisinopril label states the racial difference qualitatively and gives no percentage; these are class figures from enalapril.

provenance.source: EMA PRAC signal EPITT 19138, EMA/PRAC/595696/2018, SmPC 5.1 wording
provenance.quote: High HCTZ use (>=50,000 mg cumulative) was associated with an adjusted OR of 1.29 (95% CI: 1.23-1.35) for BCC and 3.98 (95% CI: 3.68-4.31) for SCC.

provenance.source: FDA label, hydrochlorothiazide tablets USP — WARNINGS
provenance.quote: Hydrochlorothiazide, a sulfonamide, can cause an idiosyncratic reaction, resulting in acute transient myopia and acute angle-closure glaucoma. Symptoms include acute onset of decreased visual acuity or ocular pain and typically occur within hours to weeks of drug initiation. ... The primary treatment is to discontinue hydrochlorothiazide as rapidly as possible.
provenance.note: No incidence figure is given in the label - idiosyncratic. Do not assign a percentage.

warning.short: Visible adverse effect channels
warning.full: Amlodipine peripheral edema is strongly dose-dependent: 1.8% at 2.5 mg, 3.0% at 5 mg, 10.8% at 10 mg versus 0.6% on placebo, and more common in women. ACE inhibitor cough is 2.5% above placebo in label trials but about 11.5% in pooled real-world data — use the real-world figure. Hydrochlorothiazide carries a cumulative-dose-dependent non-melanoma skin cancer risk (SCC odds ratio 3.98 at 50,000 mg cumulative) and a rare idiosyncratic acute angle-closure glaucoma reaction within hours to weeks of starting.

evidence.source: FDA label, hydrochlorothiazide tablets USP — current US NMSC labeling
evidence.quote: Non-melanoma Skin Cancer: Instruct patients taking hydrochlorothiazide to protect skin from the sun and undergo regular skin cancer screening.
